sections.heading: Type power
lines: Fire Spin, Flame Burst, Flame Charge, and Inferno also count as Ghost for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Astonish, Bitter Blade, Bone Club, Bone Rush, Bonemerang, Burning Jealousy, Fire Spin, Flame Burst, Flame Charge, Inferno, and Torch Song: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Ghost-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Judgment, Origin Pulse, Purify, and Sacred Fire change the field into Blessed.
Dazzling Gleam and Flash break the field apart, exposing whatever lay beneath it.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Soul Eater restores 1/16 of its HP.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Magical Seed: Defense +1, Special Defense +1, and suffers burn.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
